definitions.explanation: Causing complete destruction or ruin; so severe as to make recovery extremely difficult.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}は{壊滅的|かいめつてき}な{被害|ひがい}をもたらした。
{経済|けいざい}に{壊滅的|かいめつてき}な{打撃|だげき}を{与|あた}えた。
examples.english: It dealt a catastrophic blow to the economy.

examples.japanese: {壊滅的|かいめつてき}な{状況|じょうきょう}から{復興|ふっこう}した。
examples.english: They recovered from a devastating situation.

examples.japanese: {敵|てき}{軍|ぐん}に{壊滅的|かいめつてき}な{敗北|はいぼく}を{喫|きっ}した。
examples.english: They suffered a crushing defeat at the hands of the enemy.

notes:
FORMATION: {壊滅|かいめつ} (annihilation, destruction) + {的|てき} (adjectival suffix)

FORMS:
・{壊滅的|かいめつてき}な＋noun (attributive)
・{壊滅的|かいめつてき}に＋verb (adverbial)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{壊滅的|かいめつてき}な{被害|ひがい} (devastating damage)
・{壊滅的|かいめつてき}な{打撃|だげき} (catastrophic blow)
・{壊滅的|かいめつてき}な{影響|えいきょう} (devastating impact)
・{壊滅的|かいめつてき}な{状況|じょうきょう} (catastrophic situation)
・{壊滅的|かいめつてき}な{敗北|はいぼく} (crushing defeat)

CONTEXT: Frequently used in news reporting about natural disasters, military conflicts, economic crises, and other severe situations.

RELATED TERMS:
・{壊滅|かいめつ} - annihilation, destruction
・{壊滅|かいめつ}する - to be destroyed/annihilated
・{破壊的|はかいてき} - destructive
・{致命的|ちめいてき} - fatal, critical
